g.title: ECE
g.text: Proposed knowledge platform with open-source components

g.title: cluster_sources
g.text: 1. Evidence sources | synthetic fixtures in ECE

g.title: gateway
g.text: Source IDs, timestamps and access labels

g.title: event
g.text: Dagster sensors; Kafka only if justified

g.title: sensitivity
g.text: No indexing or user alerts while held

g.title: draft
g.text: MLflow optional; model license check required

g.title: retrieval
g.text: Graph context; domain / site / region filters

g.title: personas
g.text: Reviewers use a separate Silver queue

g.title: live
g.text: Mocked in ECE; production in consumers

g.title: governance
g.text: High / medium / low quality; versioned semantics
Audit, retention, lineage and access revocation

g.title: evaluation
g.text: Hidden truth accessible only to evaluator
Separate credentials, stores, catalogs and traces
Never exposed through retrieval or live adapters

g.title: operations
g.text: SME corrections return to Silver review

g.title: legend
g.text: Solid arrow: request / response Dashed arrow: asynchronous or batch
Dotted line: semantic association Dashed box: optional consumer integration
All capabilities are proposed; this is not a deployment inventory.
